body:
Looks already fixed on upstream/main c4ac3ce6d: the test `a_band_touching_only_the_shank_top_does_not_widen_the_judged_shank` (`crates/tools/src/holder_profile_tests.rs`) passes without a change. Suggest closing; the maintainer decides.

Evidence:

- Commit 2aafba7eb (PR #2207, `Fixes #2199`) changed `HolderProfile::enclose`. Its message names #2180.
- `enclose` now calls `span_reach`, not `reach_over`. `span_reach` uses strict bounds. A band that only touches `shank_top` adds 0 to `shank_d`.
- The test uses the example of this issue: `EM-0400-2FL` with a cone from r 10 to r 30 at the shank top. It asserts that `shank_d` stays Ø12 and that `holder_d` is 60 mm or more.
- The band still counts for the holder cylinder above the shank top. Thus no collision law reads a smaller body than the real one.
- `reach_over` keeps its inclusive bounds. Only tests call it now.

Answers to the open questions:

- The bound is now exclusive at the shank top. A band that crosses the shank top still widens the shank (`the_enclosing_cylinder_never_shrinks_the_body` pins that).
- PR #2207 changed no existing test. Thus no test pinned the widening at a touching band.

No claim was made. No code was changed.
